Project info:

We worked with 121G to create a striking, minimalist brand and website for their venture fund focused on investing in NFTs. The aim was to move away from typical corporate VC styling and instead build something confident, clean, and full of character, reflecting the energy and disruption of the Web3 space.

What we did:

Using a distinctive colour palette I created a stripped-back layout, and a set of simple geometric illustrations. The design balances clarity and confidence, giving the fund a distinctive visual voice that stands out in the Web3 and NFT space while remaining modern and highly functional.
